name: PDBbind Database: Biomolecular Binding Affinity and Structural Complex Database
description: The PDBbind database is a comprehensive collection of experimentally determined binding affinity data ($K_d$, $K_i$, and $IC_{50}$) for biomolecular complexes deposited in the Protein Data Bank (PDB). Curated by the Institute of Organic Chemistry at the Chinese Academy of Sciences, the v2020 release contains 23,496 structural complexes across protein-ligand, nucleic acid-ligand, and protein-protein interactions, serving as the foundational benchmark for structure-based drug design, molecular docking, and scoring functions.
